title: Maximum Value of an Ordered Triplet I
summary: Given an integer array nums, find the maximum value of (nums[i] - nums[j]) * nums[k] for all indices i < j < k.
statement: Given an integer array nums, find the maximum value of (nums[i] - nums[j]) * nums[k] for all indices i < j < k. If no such triplet exists, return 0.
constraints: Return the maximum value among all ordered triplets.
Return zero when every triplet value is negative.
reference_solution:
def maximum_ordered_triplet_value(nums):
    largest=nums[0];best_difference=0;answer=0
    for value in nums[1:]:
        answer=max(answer,best_difference*value)
        best_difference=max(best_difference,largest-value)
        largest=max(largest,value)
    return answer

def maximum_ordered_triplet_value(nums):
    largest=nums[0];best_difference=0;answer=0
    for value in nums[1:]:
        answer=max(answer,best_difference*value)
        best_difference=max(best_difference,value-largest)

hints: Before each k, retain the best difference nums[i]-nums[j] formed entirely to its left.
Also retain the largest prefix value to update that difference when j advances.
Use the current value as k before incorporating it into the prefix states.
The maintained maximum covers every valid i,j pair, so multiplying it at each later k examines the best triplet ending there.
